_about: Synthetic sandbox mailbox for `athena eval` (all names, numbers and addresses are made up). Dates are when each email was sent, UTC, as email-mcp shows them. The frozen now is Friday 2026-11-13 09:30 New York time. Ids n01..n50 are generated noise (shop orders, receipts, travel ads) sent Nov 3-13, so real bookings sink below the newest-first result cap the way they do in a busy inbox.
